text:
CEOs can add managers to their
organisation. This tutorial uses fictional
Open Users and select the Managers tab.

Select New manager. You can also choose
Add manager from your account menu.
Enter their first and last name.

Keep Internal manager as the manager type,
and add a job title.

Add their work email and mobile number.
The invitation is sent to this email

Select Create manager. Crewflow queues the
invitation and opens their details.

Their status shows the invitation until
they set a password and sign in.
